versions.content: The target address of diagnostic requests received via a generic connection can be provided in the MetaDataItem TARGET_ADDRESS_16 received via Dcm_StartOfReception(). In this case, the Dcm shall ignore physical requests where the target address is not equal to the configured ECU address DcmDspProtocolE- cuAddr .
